title: A compact solution for vibrotactile proprioceptive feedback of wrist rotation and hand aperture
abstract: Closing the control loop between users and their prostheses by providing artificial sensory feedback is a fundamental step toward the full restoration of lost sensory-motor functions.
keywords: Closed-loop control; Gaussian interpolation; Hannes hand; Multichannel stimulation; Proprioceptive feedback; Spatial encoding; Vibromotors

title: Sensory stimulation for upper limb amputations modulates adaptability of cortical large-scale systems and combination of somatosensory and visual inputs
abstract: Touch-like phantom limb sensations can be elicited through targeted transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (tTENS) in individuals with upper limb amputation.
keywords: sensory stimulation; upper limb amputation; cortical large-scale systems; EEG; tTENS
